6 guests3 bedrooms2 bathroomsHot tub on the deckDogs welcome

About the cabin

Fernhollow is a hand-built log cabin on four acres of woodland, with its own little dock on Lake Laurel. Wake up to mist on the water, paddle out in the canoe, and finish the day in the hot tub under the stars.

Inside there's a stone fireplace, a big farmhouse kitchen and a loft bedroom kids love. The Wi-Fi is fast enough for video calls, though most guests forget about it.

What's here

  • Hot tub for 6
  • Wood fireplace, logs supplied
  • Canoe and two kayaks
  • Private dock
  • Fast Wi-Fi
  • Full kitchen
  • Fire pit with chairs
  • Board games and a record player

House rules

  • Check in after 4pm, check out by 11am
  • Up to 6 guests. No parties or events
  • Up to 2 dogs, $40 per stay. Please keep them off the beds
  • Quiet hours from 10pm to 8am, sound carries over the lake
  • No smoking inside. The fire pit is fine
  • Please load the dishwasher and take the trash to the bins by the road
Hosted by Ben and CarlaThey live 10 minutes away and usually reply within an hour.
